# Jamin (@justjammin)

> AI and backend engineer. Builds agent tooling: prompt engineering, multi-agent
> orchestration, RAG and MCP servers, on a backend foundation of Symfony, APIs and
> cloud delivery.

Personal portfolio at https://justjammin.github.io/. Single page, all content in the
initial HTML, so no client-side rendering is required to read it.

## Profile

- Name: Jamin, handle `justjammin`
- Specialty: scalability + ingenuity
- Focus areas: AI, agents, backend, growth
- Education: Lewis University; MIT OpenCourseWare and AWS certification
- GitHub: https://github.com/justjammin
- Gists: https://gist.github.com/justjammin

## Skills

- Agent tooling: prompt engineering, multi-agent orchestration, MCP servers, agent routing
- Retrieval: RAG, hybrid retrieval (dense vectors, BM25, graph PPR), cross-encoder
  reranking, vector databases, context engineering
- Daily driver: TypeScript, Node.js, Next.js, Vue, Tailwind
- Also fluent: Python, Go, C#, PHP, Symfony, REST APIs, Flask
- Delivery: CI/CD, Kubernetes, AWS, LLMOps
- Growth: marketing, analytics, digital, social, community, service, teaching

## Projects

- [promper](https://github.com/justjammin/promper): Prompt-engineering toolkit for Claude
  Code. Decomposes a rough intent, walks the agent map to find the specialist the task
  belongs to, and borrows that agent's persona as the prompt's role rather than inventing
  one. `/prim` grades agents against the standard. TypeScript.
- [LENA](https://github.com/justjammin/lena): Personal agent harness with context
  engineering, multi-agent orchestration and RAG skillsets. Python.
- [GAVEL](https://github.com/justjammin/gavel): Loop engineering framework for verifiable
  agent runs. Contracts are armed RED and frozen before work starts, so an agent cannot
  grade its own output.
- [invokerai](https://github.com/justjammin/invokerai): Routes tasks to the right agent
  using offline ML. 60+ curated agents, MCP server for 20+ editors. Python.
- [RAG against the machine](https://github.com/justjammin/RAG-against-the-machine): Codebase
  question answering with cited answers. Hybrid retrieval plus cross-encoder rerank. Python.
- [Shannon](https://github.com/justjammin/shannon): Autonomous white-box AI pentester for
  web applications and APIs. TypeScript.
- [Legible](https://writelegible.com): Writing tracker for authors. iOS, full stack.
- [Sight Words](https://sightwords-lvup.onrender.com/): Sight words and spelling practice,
  built for a kindergarten reader. TypeScript, full stack.
- [Share The Wealth](https://github.com/justjammin/share-the-wealth): Mirror tracker with UI
  and ETL-style workflows. Python.
